# Aunt Atossa

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Spencervale  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)</sub>

- **Family:** [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Aunt Atossa has gray hair, which is kept in a decidedly untidy fashion. She wears a faded old wrapper.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021)_

## Personality

Aunt Atossa is a remarkably disagreeable and sarcastic individual known for her sharp tongue. She acts maliciously toward others, frequently going out of her way to put a bad flavor in everything.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P20](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0020), [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)_

## History

Aunt Atossa was a sour and critical resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) returned to town, they stopped by Aunt Atossa's home to leave her some jelly. Later, local gossip circulated that Aunt Atossa had accurately predicted [Anne](../character/anne.md) would refuse [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's marriage proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 ch.Life P2](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0002), [v3 ch.Life P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 ch.Life P5](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0005), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), +92 more_

## Quotes

> "I suppose you got that notion out of some of those silly magazines you read so many of. I wonder your mother allows you. But she always spoiled you. We all thought when George married her she wouldn’t be a suitable wife for him."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P30](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0030)

> "Well, I suppose you can’t find much amusement talking to an old woman like me. It’s such a pity the boys ain’t home."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P32](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0032)

> "Mrs. Andrews was telling me you were home. She said you had improved a good deal."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)

> "I never fancy your mother’s jelly—she always makes it too sweet. However, I’ll try to worry some down. My appetite’s been dreadful poor this spring. I’m far from well,"
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P26](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0026)

> "I hear you are to be married in June, Diana."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P36](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-atossa--josie-pye.md)

Aunt Atossa is a relative of [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), as Josie's mother is Aunt Atossa's cousin. Despite this family connection, the two do not interact directly when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends set up their residence at Patty's Place.
